enableAgricultureHelp: Radiación solar, CAPE, temperatura del suelo, irradiancia en *.agriculture
enableComfortHelp: Índice de calor, sensación térmica, humidex, índice UV en *.comfort
hourlyDaysExceedsDaysCount: No debe superar el número de días de pronóstico
widgetHint: Cada widget genera un punto de datos HTML en ubicación.widget.widgetID. Obtenga IP y puerto del adaptador web.
hourlyDaysHighWarning: Cada día horario genera muchos puntos de datos según las opciones activadas

warnExcludeKeywordsHelp: Palabras separadas por comas – las alertas que contengan alguna de ellas no generarán notificación
widgetDetailedNoHourly: Datos por hora desactivados – activar días por hora en ajustes generales
widgetDetailedNoAstronomy: Astronomía desactivada – no se mostrará el icono de fase lunar
warningsOpenMeteoHint: Las advertencias llegan tan lejos en el futuro como se obtienen datos por hora.
notificationManagerMissingHint: Notifications are sent via the ioBroker notification system. To receive messages (e.g. via Telegram, Signal or email), the "notification-manager" adapter must be installed and configured.
notificationManagerFoundHint: The 'notification-manager' adapter is installed. Go to its settings to configure notification channels (e.g. Telegram, email). The settings on this page only affect openmeteo-notify.
notificationManagerNotRunningHint: The 'notification-manager' adapter is installed but not currently running. Start it in the adapter settings to enable notification delivery.
warnOfficialMinLevelHelp: Only send notification from this warning level onwards
warnLevelDesc1: All warnings – including preliminary information and notices
warnLevelDesc2: Standard warnings and above – e.g. frost, wind, slippery roads
warnLevelDesc3: Severe warnings and above – e.g. storm, heavy rain, severe weather
warnLevelDesc4: Extreme warnings only – highest danger level
warnIntervalMinutesHelp: How often DWD / MeteoAlarm is queried – independent of the weather update interval
widgetDetailedPartialHourly: Hourly data is only available for %s day(s) – remaining days show daily data only. Increase hourly days in General settings to cover more days.
warnNotifyLiftHelp: Sends a notification when a previously reported warning is cancelled or expires
enableWarnOfficialFetchNotifyHint: To also receive push notifications for official warnings, enable them in the Notifications tab.
widgetShowWarnBadgeHint: Enable official warnings under General → Optional data to use the badge.
warnOfficialEnableFetchHint: To use the widget warning badge, also enable official warnings under General → Optional data.
enableWarnOfficialFetchHelp: Fetches official warning data and creates data points — required for the widget warning badge.
validationBadgeNeedsWarnData: Warning badge is enabled but official warnings are not active (enable under General or Notifications).
